title: AI Maestro project registry
description: The list of projects that cross-project tools operate on — `maestro drift`, `maestro update --all`, `sync.mjs --all`, and the cockpit's portfolio mode. It replaces 'the projects that happen to sit in the same parent folder' with an explicit, ordered list, and it is the allowlist: a tool may only read or write boards belonging to a project named here.

entry.description: Either a project (has `path`) or an include of another registry (has `registry`) — never both.

name.description: How every tool refers to this project. Must be unique across the whole registry tree, since consumers key on it. Defaults to `path` when omitted.

path.description: The project's repo root. `~` is expanded. A relative path resolves against the process's working directory, so prefer absolute or ~-anchored paths.

registry.description: Include another registry file — how a group of groups is expressed. Resolved relative to the registry that names it. Cycles are an error.

status.description: `parked` keeps the project on record but excludes it from every sweep, so 'deliberately not being worked' is recorded rather than lost by deleting the entry.

kind.description: `ops` is portfolio-level tooling with no delivery pipeline of its own; `product` ships.

note.description: Free text for humans — why a project is parked, where it moved from, what owns it.
